### TUNE: Classic LE - The original Loudness Equalization feel, rebuilt as our own leveller, with one change: when you fire, only the front and your gun's copies come down, so the world stays present.
### SELF GUN: Med - Your gun pulled back to sit behind the intel: a light front duck, its echo cut and most of its boom. The middle setting.
### HRIR: D2 KEMAR - The head these tunes were tuned on. Try it if sounds do not place right for you, front against back or high against low.
### OUTPUT: Needs the Art Tune + (16ch) output.
